rachats.citation: In November 2017, Invitation Homes merged with Starwood Waypoint, a corporate spin-off of Starwood Capital Group.
In January 2026, the company acquired ResiBuilt, an Atlanta-based homebuilder and developer, for 89 million.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
